bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; prohibiting manufacturers from advertising prescription drugs on television; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325F.7845] PHARMACEUTICAL ADVERTISING.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For the purposes of this section, the terms defined in this subdivision have the meanings given.

(b) "Manufacturer" means a drug manufacturer licensed under section 151.252.

(c) "Prescription drug" has the meaning provided in section 151.441, subdivision 8.

Subd. 2.

Prohibition.

A manufacturer is prohibited from using televised advertisements to advertise the direct sale of prescription drugs to consumers.

Subd. 3.

Enforcement.

The attorney general may enforce this section under section 8.31.
additions: (a) For the purposes of this section, the terms defined in this subdivision have the meanings given.

(c) "Prescription drug" has the meaning provided in section 151.441, subdivision 8.
A manufacturer is prohibited from using televised advertisements to advertise the direct sale of prescription drugs to consumers.
The attorney general may enforce this section under section 8.31.

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; prohibiting the advertisement of prescription drugs on television; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325F.7845] PHARMACEUTICAL ADVERTISING.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For the purposes of this section, the terms defined in this subdivision have the meanings given.

(b) "Prescription drug" has the meaning provided in section 151.441, subdivision 8, except that prescription drug only includes drugs covered by the medical assistance program, MinnesotaCare program, or state employees group insurance program.

(c) "Television advertisement" means a form of paid marketing communication designed to promote products, services, or brands through an over-the-air broadcast or an internet-based, nonbroadcast stream of an over-the-air broadcast.

Subd. 2.

Prohibition.

Television advertisements for the sale of prescription drugs to consumers are prohibited.

Subd. 3.

Enforcement.

The attorney general may enforce this section under section 8.31.
additions: (a) For the purposes of this section, the terms defined in this subdivision have the meanings given.

(b) "Prescription drug" has the meaning provided in section 151.441, subdivision 8, except that prescription drug only includes drugs covered by the medical assistance program, MinnesotaCare program, or state employees group insurance program.

(c) "Television advertisement" means a form of paid marketing communication designed to promote products, services, or brands through an over-the-air broadcast or an internet-based, nonbroadcast stream of an over-the-air broadcast.
Television advertisements for the sale of prescription drugs to consumers are prohibited.
The attorney general may enforce this section under section 8.31.
